Remark
[Singularity models] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0030 1. ch17:17.9\group Finite Time Singularities

A finite-time singularity model is a complete ancient pointed limit of parabolic rescalings of a finite-time singular Ricci flow on a closed manifold.
